title: Quadrotor Sandbox
description: Pilot seven distinct aircraft through a collider-rich city with real flight models, wind, sensing, tuning, landings, and launch staging.

prompt.objective: Build an open-city flight sandbox with seven believable vehicles.

mintAssets.brief: Seven craft: quadrotor, helicopter, plane, jet, flying wing, launch stack, and starship.
City towers, rooftops, a runway, and industrial obstacles.

experience: Pilot, switch, reset, and land with keyboard or gamepad.
Simulate PID hover, fixed-wing lift, rocket staging, wind, collisions, sensing, and landing grades.
prompt.visualDirection: Realistic aircraft, a crisp city, and amber instruments.

thumbnail.alt: A shuttle launch stack climbing above a modern city with glowing engine plumes and live flight telemetry.
